title: Nowhere To Go
summary:
Domestic turmoil and regional tensions restrict oil exports
Sudan and South Sudan are two countries in Northeast Africa. They were one country until 2011, when South Sudan seceded and became independent following a referendum. The political situation in the region is very unstable.
